findings: Fine neovascular capillary arcade forming at the superior edge of the optic nerve head
Moderate venous dilations and vessel caliber irregularity across superior arcade branch
Multiple intraretinal dot hemorrhages scattered across nasal and temporal quadrants
Focal area of capillary non-perfusion suspected along superior temporal vascular distribution
Absence of preretinal hemorrhage or tractional retinal elevation
maculaStatus: Central macula clear with well-preserved foveal reflex; no hard exudates within 1 disc diameter.
opticDiscStatus: Disc margin partially obscured superiorly by early neovascular growth (NVD).
riskIndicators: High risk of proliferative progression and potential vitreous bleeding if untreated
Ischemic drive indicates need for early anti-VEGF or laser photocoagulation
recommendation: Urgent retinal specialist referral recommended within 2 weeks.
analysisSummary: AI screening indicates proliferative diabetic retinopathy with active disc neovascularization. Vascular tortuosity and surrounding microvascular changes highlight significant retinal ischemia. Prompt specialist evaluation for panretinal laser or anti-VEGF therapy is recommended to prevent disease progression.
differentialConsiderations: Ocular ischemic syndrome evaluated; presentation aligns with proliferative diabetic microangiopathy.
